name: Csikóstőttős (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner charged near the top with the municipal arms of Csikóstőttős: a quartered blue and yellow shield with a bunch of grapes, a horse, a wheel and waves, inscribed CSIKÓSTŐTTŐS.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
